Pilot · United Kingdom

Eric Moody

British Airways Flight 91982
Flight
British Airways Flight 9
Date
24 June 1982
Aircraft
Boeing 747-200
Location
Jakarta, Indonesia
Survivors
263 of 263 aboard

All four engines of the Boeing 747 failed after it flew through volcanic ash over Indonesia. His crew restarted them and landed in Jakarta, and everyone aboard survived.

Who helped

  • Barry Townley-Freeman Senior engineer officer (flight engineer)Monitored the engines, called out each failure and worked with the pilots through repeated restart attempts until the engines relit.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Roger Greaves Senior first officerSent the mayday call to Jakarta, helped with the engine restart attempts and gave the captain glideslope guidance on the approach.Sources: 1 2 3 4
